answer: Factory agents rank repairs for pigment leaks at an inlet or cracks in a roof ridge. Each vote irreversibly burns one fixed-supply coin. A tally contract checks public burn records and owner-signed ballots, counting each ID once with no key bonus. Conflicting owner-signed ballots void that burn's vote at round close; its coin stays destroyed. A 100-coin budget buys at most 100 votes across 1, 10 or 100 keys, including parallel clones and colluders. Wealth can dominate; a compromised tally counting 101 votes from 100 burns breaks the cap. This does not prove unique humans.
